card.name: Organ adjectives before condition terms
card.fires_on: Organ adjectives such as pulmonary, renal, lung and ovarian (including partway through Pulmonary or Ovarian), right before a condition or procedure noun like edema, embolism, transplant, artery or cysts. Seen in warnings sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Pulmonary before edema or embolism
modes.description: The word pulmonary right after a linking word, naming a lung complication.

modes.description: Renal or lung used as an organ adjective in a patient group or condition.
